review: All eight transcripts preserve the intended new lines, including Mogryacha gajra ghya, Amchya veli, Paaoos yenaar ka and the matching rain reply. Differences are punctuation, nukta spelling and the English loanword cycle. Each sample is tied to its runtime SHA-256 hash.
limits: A sampled content check, not certification of a native accent or a human listening review. Every MP3 is separately covered by checksums, duration checks and complete decoding.
